mutants.name: Bypass min_length validation
mutants.description: Disable minimum length enforcement so short passwords pass without error.

mutants.name: Bypass custom validator function
mutants.description: Remove custom validator callback invocation in prompt so invalid passwords pass silently.

mutants.name: Bypass alias dispatch lookup
mutants.description: Disable alias resolution in Group.get_command so invoking via alias fails to resolve.

mutants.name: Omit aliases from help formatting
mutants.description: Omit alias annotations from Group.format_commands output.

mutants.name: Ignore json help_format flag
mutants.description: Always return standard text help even when ctx.help_format is 'json'.

mutants.name: Omit subcommands from JSON payload
mutants.description: MultiCommand.to_help_dict omits child command details from the generated JSON.

mutants.name: Hardcode single underscore delimiter
mutants.description: Ignore custom nested_envvar_delimiter and always use standard '_'.

mutants.name: Disable nested prefix inheritance
mutants.description: Child context fails to inherit nested_auto_envvar setting from parent.

mutants.name: Suppress deprecation runtime warning
mutants.description: Do not emit ClickDeprecationWarning when deprecated option is passed on CLI.

mutants.name: Omit Deprecated tag from help text
mutants.description: Option.get_help_record omits [Deprecated: ...] metadata from help output.
